meta.title: Launch readiness scorecard: is your idea ready?
meta.description: 12 questions, two minutes. Find out whether your idea is ready to launch as a SaaS, with an instant result and a clear next step.

intro.h1: Is your idea ready to launch?
intro.lead: Answer 12 short questions and get your result straight away. It takes about two minutes.

business.prompt: Do you run a business today?

options.lt1m: Yes, under SAR 1M a year in revenue

budget.prompt: What budget can you commit in the next 60 days?

marketer.prompt: Who will market the product after launch?

audience.prompt: Do you have existing customers or an audience?

model.prompt: Which model or idea interests you?
model.other: Something else, or not sure yet

timeline.prompt: When do you want to launch?

decisionMaker.prompt: Are you the final decision-maker on this project?

soldOnline.prompt: Have you sold anything online before?

hours.prompt: How many hours a week can you give the launch?

commercialReg.prompt: Do you have a commercial registration?

success.prompt: What would success look like six months from now?
success.placeholder: e.g. 50 customers paying a monthly subscription
success.hint: We'll read this before the call. You can skip it.

contact.title: Where should we send your result?
contact.reason: So we can send you your detailed result

result.invalid: This result link has expired or isn't valid.

ready.title: Your idea is ready to launch
ready.body: Next step: a free 15-minute fit call with one of the founders. Pick a time that suits you.
next: We get to know your idea and your customers.
We tell you honestly whether we're the right fit.
If we are, we schedule your Blueprint session.

almost.title: You're close, with a few things to prepare
almost.body: Your idea deserves attention, but a few things need sorting before a build. Here's what will help with the next step.
almost.whatsappMessage: Hi, I finished the scorecard with {score}/100. What am I missing to launch?
almost.retakeNote: When things change, retake the scorecard and we'll look at your result again.

explore.title: Learn first, build later
explore.body: Building right now may not be your best next step. These free resources will help you choose and prepare your idea.
explore.newsletter: Get new models in your inbox

reasons.budget:lt2k: The budget is below the minimum for a build.
reasons.budget:2to5k: The budget is below the minimum for a build.

reasons.timeline:later: Your launch date is more than six months away.
reasons.marketer:etleq: We build and run the product; marketing stays with you.
